mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_SF_INCIDENT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SF_INCIDENT (INCIDENT_ID, TITLE, DISASTER_TYPE, SEVERITY, STATUS, REGION, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, ASSIGNED_STAFF_ID, SOURCE_REPORT_ID) VALUES (#{incidentId}, #{title}, #{disasterType}, #{severity}, 'RECEIVED', #{region}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{assignedStaffId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{sourceReportId,jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, m.NAME AS ASSIGNED_STAFF_NAME, FROM SF_INCIDENT i LEFT JOIN SF_MEMBER m ON i.ASSIGNED_STAFF_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE i.INCIDENT_ID = #{incidentId}
mapper.sql: JOIN (SELECT INCIDENT_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CREATED_AT, INCIDENT_ID) AS INCIDENT_RANK FROM SF_INCIDENT) rk ON rk.INCIDENT_ID = i.INCIDENT_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT i.*, m.NAME AS ASSIGNED_STAFF_NAME, , rk.INCIDENT_RANK FROM SF_INCIDENT i
LEFT JOIN SF_MEMBER m ON i.ASSIGNED_STAFF_ID = m.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT DESC

sql.if: AND (LOWER(i.TITLE) LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR LOWER(i.REGION) LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR LOWER(i.DISASTER_TYPE) LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' ESCAPE '\')

mapper.select:
SELECT i.*, m.NAME AS ASSIGNED_STAFF_NAME, , rk.INCIDENT_RANK FROM SF_INCIDENT i
LEFT JOIN SF_MEMBER m ON i.ASSIGNED_STAFF_ID = m.MEMBER_ID
AND i.STATUS = #{status}
ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ASC, i.INCIDENT_ID ASC ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT DESC, i.INCIDENT_ID DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN i.STATUS = 'RECEIVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS RECEIVED_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN i.STATUS = 'CONFIRMING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS CONFIRMING_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN i.STATUS = 'RESPONDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS RESPONDING_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN i.STATUS = 'RECOVERING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS RECOVERING_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN i.STATUS = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS CLOSED_COUNT FROM SF_INCIDENT i
SELECT i.*, FROM SF_INCIDENT i WHERE REGION = #{region} AND STATUS != 'CLOSED' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT i.*, FROM SF_INCIDENT i WHERE STATUS != 'CLOSED' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE SF_INCIDENT SET TITLE = #{title}, DISASTER_TYPE = #{disasterType}, SEVERITY = #{severity}, REGION = #{region}, LATITUDE = #{latitude}, LONGITUDE = #{longitude}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE INCIDENT_ID = #{incidentId}

UPDATE SF_INCIDENT SET ASSIGNED_STAFF_ID = #{staffId}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE INCIDENT_ID = #{incidentId} AND ASSIGNED_STAFF_ID IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SF_MEMBER m WHERE m.MEMBER_ID = #{staffId} AND m.ROLE = 'STAFF' AND m.IS_WITHDRAWN = 'N' )

SELECT DISASTER_TYPE, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CREATED_AT >= #{monthStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS CURRENT_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CREATED_AT < #{monthStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS PREV_COUNT FROM SF_INCIDENT WHERE CREATED_AT >= #{prevMonthStart} AND CREATED_AT < #{nextMonthStart} GROUP BY DISASTER_TYPE
